name: NeRF-SH
aliases: modified NeRF that predicts spherical harmonic coefficients
definition: A modified Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) network trained to predict spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients instead of raw RGB color values, allowing the viewing direction to be removed as a direct input to the neural network and enabling storage in a PlenOctree.
summary: NeRF-SH replaces direct RGB output with spherical harmonic coefficients, enabling efficient octree storage and real-time rendering without view-direction inputs.
